sources.title: Ocean County Clerk's Office, 2026-2030 Ocean County Official Republican County Committee List, updated as of 10/2/2026 (24 pages; each seat marked B = election via ballot, W = election via write-in vote, A = appointed by municipal chair, or Vacant)
Ocean County Clerk Election Services archives page (links the Republican County Committee List and bylaws)
Ocean County 2026 Primary Election Official Winners List, updated as of June 22, 2026 (lists municipal and county offices only, no county committee)
N.J.S.A. 19:5-3 (one committeeman and one committeewoman per election district)

notes: Evidence is the county clerk's official Republican county committee roster for the 2026-2030 term, updated October 2, 2026: two seats in each of 418 election districts. Filled = a listed member (637 elected on the ballot, 7 elected by write-in, 17 appointed by the municipal chair after the election); empty = a seat listed as 'Vacant' (175). The roster does not label seats as male or female, so seats are labeled 'Member'. The roster also prints members' addresses; only seat status is recorded here, no names or addresses. Precinct names are the roster's municipality and district number. No official county committee vote totals were found (the 2026 winners list omits county committee, and the clerk's results archive lists primary results without links).
